topic: Page likely conflates Iran North Pars LNG with Qatar's North Field expansion
wiki_text: Suggested corrected narrative: North Pars LNG was a National Iranian Oil Co proposal to liquefy gas from Iran's North Pars field (distinct from Qatar's North Field expansion on the Qatari side of the shared structure). CNOOC and NIOC signed an MoU in September 2006, extended in December 2006 to a four-train, 20 mtpa LNG development; a ~US$16 billion development contract was reported in 2008 but never finalized. The last live plan (April 2010) put the plant in the Tombak region with construction from 2013 and startup in 2014. CNOOC withdrew as US/EU sanctions ramped up in 2011/12, and by mid-2013 the project was assessed as having made no progress. GEM infers shelved 2012 and cancelled 2014. Iran's 2025-26 revival of North Pars is a domestic-gas field development with no LNG component.
